rationale: S-0048-01 proposes a GABA conductance scan at Voff_bipNMDA = 1 to close the residual DSI gap to the paper's 0.30 line on the deposited Poleg-Polsky 2016 ModelDB 189347 substrate. Brainstorm session 9 retired the deposited-DSGC line as the canonical platform. The closely related question - what GABA operating point preserves DSI under NMDA-amplified excitation - is now being addressed on the from-scratch substrate by t0054 + t0055 + (forthcoming) S-0054-02. Reprioritising from high to medium.
